card.name: Small words before place or name
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, of, and, at, the) or a single capital letter that start a place, school or proper name, mostly in artist biographies. Also a lone capital C starting a list item or name.

modes.label: Linking word in biography
modes.description: A small word like to, of, at or and just before a place, school or person in a painter's life story.
modes.example: He was educated at the Collège de Beauvais, and was then sent<< to>> study theology at the Sorbonne.

modes.label: Capital letter starting a name
modes.description: A single capital letter that begins a food, town or term in a list.
modes.example: : CABBAGE FAMILY: includes Broccoli, Brussels Sprouts, Cauliflower, Kohlrabi MARROW FAMILY: includes Courgette,<< C>>ucumber, Pumpkin, Squash ON
